paragraphs.text: Put them in mind to be in subjection to rulers, to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready unto every good work,
paragraphs.original: Ὑπομίμνῃσκε αὐτοὺς ἀρχαῖς ἐξουσίαις ὑποτάσσεσθαι πειθαρχεῖν, πρὸς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἑτοίμους εἶναι,
paragraphs.translit: Hypomimnēske autous archais exousiais hypotassesthai peitharchein, pros pan ergon agathon hetoimous einai,

paragraphs.text: to speak evil of no man, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all meekness toward all men.
paragraphs.original: μηδένα βλασφημεῖν, ἀμάχους εἶναι, ἐπιεικεῖς, πᾶσαν ἐνδεικνυμένους πραΰτητα πρὸς πάντας ἀνθρώπους.
paragraphs.translit: mēdena blasphēmein, amachous einai, epieikeis, pasan endeiknymenous prautēta pros pantas anthrōpous.

paragraphs.text: For we also once were foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, hating one another.
paragraphs.original: ἦμεν γάρ ποτε καὶ ἡμεῖς ἀνόητοι, ἀπειθεῖς, πλανώμενοι, δουλεύοντες ἐπιθυμίαις καὶ ἡδοναῖς ποικίλαις, ἐν κακίᾳ καὶ φθόνῳ διάγοντες, στυγητοί, μισοῦντες ἀλλήλους.
paragraphs.translit: ēmen gar pote kai hēmeis anoētoi, apeitheis, planōmenoi, douleuontes epithymiais kai hēdonais poikilais, en kakia kai phthonō diagontes, stygētoi, misountes allēlous.

paragraphs.text: But when the kindness of God our Saviour, and his love toward man, appeared,
paragraphs.original: ὅτε δὲ ἡ χρηστότης καὶ ἡ φιλανθρωπία ἐπεφάνη τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν θεοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: hote de hē chrēstotēs kai hē philanthrōpia epephanē tou sōtēros hēmōn theou,

paragraphs.text: not by works [done] in righteousness, which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy he saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Spirit,
paragraphs.original: οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων τῶν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ ἃ ἐποιήσαμεν ἡμεῖς ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸ αὐτοῦ ἔλεος ἔσωσεν ἡμᾶς διὰ λουτροῦ παλιγγενεσίας καὶ ἀνακαινώσεως πνεύματος ἁγίου,
paragraphs.translit: ouk ex ergōn tōn en dikaiosynē ha epoiēsamen hēmeis alla kata to autou eleos esōsen hēmas dia loutrou palingenesias kai anakainōseōs pneumatos hagiou,

paragraphs.text: which he poured out upon us richly, through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
paragraphs.original: οὗ ἐξέχεεν ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς πλουσίως διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν,
paragraphs.translit: hou execheen ephʼ hēmas plousiōs dia Iēsou Christou tou sōtēros hēmōn,

paragraphs.text: that, being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα δικαιωθέντες τῇ ἐκείνου χάριτι κληρονόμοι γενηθῶμεν κατʼ ἐλπίδα ζωῆς αἰωνίου.
paragraphs.translit: hina dikaiōthentes tē ekeinou chariti klēronomoi genēthōmen katʼ elpida zōēs aiōniou.

paragraphs.text: Faithful is the saying, and concerning these things I desire that thou affirm confidently, to the end that they who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men:
paragraphs.original: Πιστὸς ὁ λόγος, καὶ περὶ τούτων βούλομαί σε διαβεβαιοῦσθαι, ἵνα φροντίζωσιν καλῶν ἔργων προΐστασθαι οἱ πεπιστευκότες θεῷ. ταῦτά ἐστιν καλὰ καὶ ὠφέλιμα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις·
paragraphs.translit: Pistos ho logos, kai peri toutōn boulomai se diabebaiousthai, hina phrontizōsin kalōn ergōn proistasthai hoi pepisteukotes theō. tauta estin kala kai ōphelima tois anthrōpois·

paragraphs.text: but shun foolish questionings, and genealogies, and strifes, and fightings about law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
paragraphs.original: μωρὰς δὲ ζητήσεις καὶ γενεαλογίας καὶ ἔρεις καὶ μάχας νομικὰς περιΐστασο, εἰσὶν γὰρ ἀνωφελεῖς καὶ μάταιοι.
paragraphs.translit: mōras de zētēseis kai genealogias kai ereis kai machas nomikas periistaso, eisin gar anōpheleis kai mataioi.

paragraphs.text: A factious man after a first and second admonition refuse;
paragraphs.original: αἱρετικὸν ἄνθρωπον μετὰ μίαν καὶ δευτέραν νουθεσίαν παραιτοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: hairetikon anthrōpon meta mian kai deuteran nouthesian paraitou,

paragraphs.text: knowing that such a one is perverted, and sinneth, being self-condemned.
paragraphs.original: εἰδὼς ὅτι ἐξέστραπται ὁ τοιοῦτος καὶ ἁμαρτάνει, ὢν αὐτοκατάκριτος.
paragraphs.translit: eidōs hoti exestraptai ho toioutos kai hamartanei, ōn autokatakritos.

paragraphs.text: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, give diligence to come unto me to Nicopolis: for there I have determined to winter.
paragraphs.original: Ὅταν πέμψω Ἀρτεμᾶν πρὸς σὲ ἢ Τυχικόν, σπούδασον ἐλθεῖν πρός με εἰς Νικόπολιν, ἐκεῖ γὰρ κέκρικα παραχειμάσαι.
paragraphs.translit: Hotan pempsō Arteman pros se ē Tychikon, spoudason elthein pros me eis Nikopolin, ekei gar kekrika paracheimasai.

paragraphs.text: Set forward Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
paragraphs.original: Ζηνᾶν τὸν νομικὸν καὶ Ἀπολλῶν σπουδαίως πρόπεμψον, ἵνα μηδὲν αὐτοῖς λείπῃ.
paragraphs.translit: Zēnan ton nomikon kai Apollōn spoudaiōs propempson, hina mēden autois leipē.

paragraphs.text: And let our [people] also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
paragraphs.original: μανθανέτωσαν δὲ καὶ οἱ ἡμέτεροι καλῶν ἔργων προΐστασθαι εἰς τὰς ἀναγκαίας χρείας, ἵνα μὴ ὦσιν ἄκαρποι.
paragraphs.translit: manthanetōsan de kai hoi hēmeteroi kalōn ergōn proistasthai eis tas anankaias chreias, hina mē ōsin akarpoi.

paragraphs.text: All that are with me salute thee. Salute them that love us in faith. Grace be with you all.
paragraphs.original: Ἀσπάζονταί σε οἱ μετʼ ἐμοῦ πάντες. ἄσπασαι τοὺς φιλοῦντας ἡμᾶς ἐν πίστει. ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Aspazontai se hoi metʼ emou pantes. aspasai tous philountas hēmas en pistei. hē charis meta pantōn hymōn.
